description: HO-01 local optimization comparison corpus. A synthetic repository-analysis task over a three-module frozen fixture. The positive family is the variable family: it carries the single declared dimension (analysis_context_depth) and is deliberately non-blocking, because this experiment measures the behavioural delta of that dimension instead of gating on it. The negative, security_regression and model_parity families are the invariant families: they are byte-identical for both arms and stay blocking, so a candidate can never win by degrading them. Identical expected blocks in both positive files make the test inputs identical; only the recorded transcript differs.
